docs.camera.title: Take a photo: {side}
docs.camera.body: Hold the document steady, fill the frame, then take the photo.
docs.camera.unavailable: The camera could not be opened. Allow this page to use the camera, or choose a file or use your phone instead.
docs.phone.title: Use your phone instead
docs.phone.body: Scan a QR code with your phone's camera to take or choose the photos there. They appear here as soon as they are added.
docs.phone.alt: QR code for adding the photos from your phone
docs.phone.left_one: This code works for {count} more minute (until {time}).
docs.phone.left_other: This code works for {count} more minutes (until {time}).
docs.phone.warning: Scan it only with your own phone. Anyone with this code can add photos here until it ends; you can remove them before sending.
phoneUpload.title: Add your document photos
phoneUpload.intro: Take or choose each photo. They go straight to your Favorite Hearts page on your computer, where you check them and send them for review.
phoneUpload.ended: This link has ended. Make a new QR code on your computer and scan it again.
phoneUpload.done.title: All photos are added
phoneUpload.done.body: Go back to your computer to check them and send them for review. You can close this page.
